description: This file defines the ExternalAPIFactory class, which provides mechanisms to load, filter, list, and manage external API integrations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for caching API configurations, loading specific API classes, and managing supported modules and authentication states.

classes.name: ExternalAPIFactory
classes.description: Factory class for discovering, filtering, loading, and managing external API services in SuiteCRM, supporting cache mechanisms and dynamic class instantiation.

methods.name: filterAPIList
methods.description: Filters out disabled or improperly configured APIs from the provided list.

methods.name: loadFullAPIList
methods.description: Loads the complete list of available external APIs, utilizing cache unless rebuild is forced.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Deletes cached API configuration files to force rebuild.

methods.name: loadAPI
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a specific API class, optionally handling authentication.

methods.name: listAPI
methods.description: Lists available APIs, optionally filtered by module and authentication status.

methods.name: getModuleDropDown
methods.description: Returns an associative array suitable for UI dropdowns, listing APIs for a given module.
